statement: Impact proof-cone selection consumes the canonical schema-v2 registry parser and matcher, honors exact, directory, and legacy filename-stem owner declarations, expands claimant tests without a second registry interpretation, fails closed to the full suite when registry inputs are invalid or selector-owning files change, and binds the registry semantic digest into its receipt.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
